$comment: Chowańce ze Sklepu Systemu w ruchu (tools/animate-mounts.mjs --config art/pets.json --group pets, PixelLab animate-with-text-v3; DECISIONS.md, „Odpowiedzi autora 415, 532 i 533”). start: wybrany szkic z art/drafts/pets (kind pets-pixellab), 64 × 64, przodem w prawo. fox-trot, raven-fly i wisp idą za postacią w scenie Walki, a fox-sit i raven-perch siedzą przy niej na portrecie. Autor: „musisz chowańce zaanimowac w PixelLab i dać do sprawdzenia”.
action: moving in place in a smooth seamless loop, seen from the side and facing right

fox-trot.description: a friendly tame red fox with a white chest, black legs and a bushy white-tipped tail
fox-trot.action: trotting at a steady pace in place, seen from the side and facing right, the four legs moving in a smooth seamless trot loop, the bushy tail swaying, the head bobbing slightly

fox-sit.description: the same friendly red fox sitting upright
fox-sit.action: sitting still in place, seen from the side and facing right, breathing slowly, the bushy tail swaying gently and the ears twitching, a calm seamless idle loop

raven-fly.description: a tame black raven with glossy blue-black feathers
raven-fly.action: flying in place, seen from the side and facing right, both wings flapping fully up and down in a smooth seamless loop, the body bobbing slightly

raven-perch.description: the same black raven perched with folded wings
raven-perch.action: perched in place, seen from the side and facing right, the wings folded, turning its head a little and ruffling its feathers, a calm seamless idle loop

wisp.description: a small tame will-o'-the-wisp, a ball of pale blue spectral fire
wisp.action: floating in place, bobbing gently up and down, the pale blue flame flickering and its flame tail swirling, a smooth seamless loop
